# Psalm 94 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 94:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** O-God-of vengeance YHWH, O-God-of vengeance shine-forth!
- **LOGOS:** O LORD, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth!
- **PNEUMA:** LORD, God of justice — God of justice, reveal yourself!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
